NO CAP FOODS — CONCEPT

A speculative visual campaign direction created by Kriyon Media to explore how NoCap could be presented across stills, motion and digital.

CONCEPT FORNoCap Foods
CONCEPT SCOPEProduct Visuals · CGI Film · Creative Direction
PITCH CONCEPTBold Flavour, Zero Compromise
YEAR2026

A proposed visual world for NoCap Foods.

Created independently by Kriyon Media as a private pitch concept for NoCap Foods, this visual exploration imagines how Beetroot Masala, Beetroot Cream & Onion and Oats Peri-Peri could live within one bold campaign world. This is speculative work, not an official brand commission.

Product visuals, CGI motion and digital-ready compositions demonstrate a possible creative direction for launches, social content, paid media and digital shelves.
